title: The Cake on the Lake
note: b385 — first use of 'cake' and the generic non-cast 'duck'. The brief's 'her name spelled out in seeds' is overridden by the absolute no-letters-or-words rule (see DEPARTURES.md convention) — the seeds built into the 'cake' prop are a decorative scatter, never legible text. 'The cake on a leaf plate' is the one 'cake' prop throughout (it already includes its own leaf plate), reused at every page rather than drawn as two separate objects.

pages.brief: Nell the bee beside a small lopsided honey-coloured cake on a leaf plate, her name spelled out in seeds on the top. She is beaming. Warm gold light.
pages.alt: Nell the bee beams beside a small lopsided cake on a leaf plate, decorated with a scatter of seeds, in warm gold light.

pages.brief: Nell hovering with the leaf plate; Moss plodding beside her at a fraction of the speed, tongue out with effort. A long path stretching ahead of them. Comic pacing.
pages.alt: Nell hovers along carrying the leaf plate while Moss plods beside her at a fraction of the speed, tongue out with effort, along a long path.

pages.brief: Moss stuck to his middle in thick brown mud, spikes flat with dismay, holding the cake plate high and clean above his head. Reeds and reflections all round.
pages.alt: Moss is stuck to his middle in thick brown mud, spikes flat with dismay, holding the cake plate up high and clean above his head.

pages.brief: The instant of disaster: Ned reaching for the plate, one foot slipping, the cake sailing off in a graceful arc towards the water. Everyone caught mid-horror. Strong diagonal.
pages.alt: The instant of disaster: Ned reaches for the plate, one foot slips, and the cake sails off in a graceful arc towards the water while everyone watches in horror.

pages.brief: Calm wide shot of the lake surface with the small cake floating serenely in the middle, perfectly upright, seeds still spelling Nell's name. Still water, soft reflections. Absurd and lovely.
pages.alt: A calm wide view of the still lake surface with the small cake floating perfectly upright in the middle, soft reflections all around — absurd and lovely.

pages.brief: Another duck swam up. Ned made a face at him and said the cake was not for him. Another duck paddling hopefully towards the floating cake; Ned in the water between it and the cake, wings spread wide and beak set. Territorial and hilarious.
pages.alt: Another duck paddles hopefully towards the floating cake, but Ned sits in the water between them with his wings spread wide and his beak set — territorial and hilarious.

pages.brief: The three of them on a flat wet rock in the shallows with the rescued cake between them, damp and happy, sharing it in crumbs. Late afternoon light on the water.
pages.alt: The three friends sit together on a flat wet rock in the shallows with the rescued cake between them, damp and happy, sharing it in crumbs in the late afternoon light.
